records.name: event.event.ticket.view.list.from.event
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <list string="Tickets" editable="bottom">
                <field name="sequence" widget="handle"/>
                <field name="name"/>
                <field name="description" optional="hide"/>
                <field name="start_sale_datetime" optional="show"/>
                <field name="end_sale_datetime" optional="show"/>
                <field name="seats_max" sum="Total" width="120px" string="Maximum" column_invisible="context.get('is_event_multi_slots')"/>
                <field name="seats_max" sum="Total" width="120px" string="Maximum per slot" column_invisible="not context.get('is_event_multi_slots')"/>
                <field name="seats_taken" sum="Total" width="120px" string="Registration" column_invisible="context.get('is_event_multi_slots')"/>
                <field name="seats_taken" sum="Total" width="120px" string="Total Registration" column_invisible="not context.get('is_event_multi_slots')"/>
                <field name="limit_max_per_order" optional="hidden"/>
                <field name="color" widget="color" optional="hidden"/>
            </list>
        </field>

records.name: event.event.ticket.view.form.from.event
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <form string="Ticket">
                <sheet>
                    <group>
                        <group>
                            <field name="name"/>
                            <field name="description"/>
                            <field name="start_sale_datetime"/>
                            <field name="end_sale_datetime"/>
                        </group><group>
                            <field name="seats_max"/>
                            <field name="seats_reserved"/>
                        </group>
                    </group>
                </sheet>
            </form>
        </field>

records.name: event.event.ticket.view.kanban.from.event
records.declaration: reserved

records.name: event.event.ticket.view.list
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <xpath expr="//list" position="attributes">
                <attribute name="editable"/>
            </xpath>
            <field name="name" position="after">
                <field name="event_id"/>
            </field>
        </field>

records.name: event.event.ticket.view.form
event.event.ticket.view.list.from.event.inherit.event.product
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <field name="start_sale_datetime" position="attributes">
                <attribute name="string">Sales Start</attribute>
            </field>
            <field name="end_sale_datetime" position="attributes">
                <attribute name="string">Sales End</attribute>
            </field>
            <field name="name" position="before">
                <field name="product_id" context="{                         'default_type': 'service',                         'default_service_tracking': 'event',                     }"/>
            </field>
            <field name="description" position="after">
                <field name="currency_id" column_invisible="True"/> 
                <field name="price" widget="monetary" options="{'currency_field': 'currency_id'}"/>
            </field>
        </field>

records.name: event.event.ticket.view.form.from.event.inherit.event.product
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <field name="name" position="before">
                <field name="product_id" context="{                         'default_type': 'service',                         'default_service_tracking': 'event',                     }"/>
            </field>
            <field name="description" position="after">
                <field name="price"/>
            </field>
        </field>

records.name: event.event.ticket.view.kanban.from.event.product
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <field name="name" position="after">
                <field class="fw-bold ms-auto" name="price"/>
            </field>
            <xpath expr="//div[hasclass('d-flex')]" position="after">
                <field name="product_id"/>
            </xpath>
        </field>

records.name: event.event.ticket.view.form.inherit.event.product
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <field name="end_sale_datetime" position="after">
                <field name="price"/>
                <field name="price_reduce" groups="base.group_no_one"/>
            </field>
            <field name="seats_used" position="after">
                <field name="product_id"/>
            </field>
        </field>
